about_the_game:
Buddies in a Ball is a chaotic co-op adventure that traps you and a friend inside of a metal ball, hurtling through wild, physics-driven obstacle courses. Work together to tackle tight turns, daring ramps, and gravity-defying challenges in multiple, game-show-inspired arenas. Your mission? Survive the madness without tipping over, falling off, or crashing into chaos!

Complete each level to uncover the twisted mystery behind why you and your buddy are trapped in this rolling metal death trap. And don’t forget – the taunting announcers and jeering fans are always ready to push you off your game.

Key Gameplay Elements:

  • Teamwork Matters: Two players control the ball together—communication and coordination are key! Solo mode available too.

  • Physics-Driven Fun: Realistic rolling physics, speed, and momentum make every level a new challenge.

  • Game-Show Vibes: The announcer keeps the action exciting, commenting on your triumphs and failures.

  • Unique Levels: Navigate ramps, jumps, obstacles, and rotating platforms in diverse arenas.

  • Leaderboards: Compete to finish each level in the fastest time.

  • Customizable Characters: Pick your favorite stick figure styles and colors!

Game Modes:

  • Easy: Access every level, unlimited respawns, no time limits, and explore the world! Leaderboards disabled.

  • Default: Race to beat the clock, respawn at the beginning of the current level when you die. Complete each level to unlock the next.

  • Hard: Beat the game in one playthrough. Progress is saved in between sessions (if you don't die). If you die, restart at level one.

  • Mentally ill: One session, one game, if you leave or die, restart from level one. You probably have or need a therapist.

  • Solo Mode: Jump in the ball alone and take on the course by yourself, weirdo. Leaderboards disabled.

Why Play Buddies in a Ball?

If you love physics-based challenges, chaotic co-op gameplay, and the thrill of surviving impossible levels, this game is for you. Whether you're strategizing with your teammate or screaming at them for rolling the wrong way, each round promises laughs and adrenaline.

  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 3.4 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
